question: Which of the following is an example of perishable foods that CANNOT be stored for more than a day or two at room temperature, i.e., they have a shelf life of 1 or 2 days?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Milk__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​**

__
 
• Perishable foods 

 
 
• **Perishable foods** are those that should be stored** frozen at 0 °F or lower or refrigerated at 40 °F** or below to prevent spoilage, deterioration, or other food safety issues.** **
 
• **Meat, poultry, fish, dairy products, **and all cooked leftovers are a few examples of foods that need to be kept chilled for safety.
 
• **Bacterial growth is slowed by refrigeration.**
 
 
 
• **​**Milk
 
 
• **Milk is a priceless, nutritious meal** that needs to be handled carefully due to its short shelf life.
 
• Because it is a great environment for the growth of germs, particularly** bacterial pathogens**, which can degrade food and infect customers, **milk is highly perishable.**
 
• Due to its ability to reduce **microbial growth and milk deterioration**, hydrogen peroxide** (H2O2)** is frequently employed as a preservative in milk and** milk products. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​​**

 
• Dried fruit 

 
 
• **Dried fruit is regarded as non-perishable** even though the majority of fresh fruits and vegetables have a short shelf life.
 
• Most dried fruit can be safely kept at **room temperature for up to a year** with proper storage, while **dried vegetables** can last around half that long.
 
 
 
• Spices
 
 
• **Spices are non-perishable foods **that can be stored at room temperature for extended periods of time without** going bad or decomposing.**
 
 
 
• **Biscuit**
 
 
• **Least perishable is the biscuit.**
 
• The least perishable items can be kept for a long period without spoiling before being** consumed or used. **
